date-tvdb.reason: AniDB S13 "Picture Drama 10" (2013-09-25, the Blu-ray bonus) goes to TVDB 79525 S0E35 "Picture Drama - Stage 0.97". Picture Drama 1 to 9 of this series (S4 to S12) are S0E16 to S0E24 "Picture Drama - Stage 0.515" to "Stage 23.95" on the same dates; Stage 0.97 is the tenth first-season picture drama, listed after them, as R2's tenth (Turn 12.06) is listed after its nine. Only the date differs.
